label: Futures Triangle
description: Maps a topic through future pull, present push, and historical weight, revealing tensions, drivers, constraints, and possible intervention points for discussion.

zh.label: 未来三角
zh.description: 从未来拉力、当下推力与历史负担三方面梳理议题，识别张力、驱动因素、限制条件与可介入的位置。

text_output_forms.primary_template: force inventory table, discussion-weight chart, tension pairs, and intervention questions

required_blocks.title: Discussion weight of forces
required_blocks.purpose: Use a 1–5 discussion weight for selected pulls, pushes, and weights; it is not a forecast or evidence score.

text_output_forms.presentation_rule: Name each pull, push, and weight before proposing action. Charts express discussion weight only.
text_output_forms.conciseness_rule: Follow output_budget: at most 3 rows or items per structured block, and no repeated prose outside the blocks.

theory_mapping.source_notes: 思辨设计tools-3.pdf pages 14-15. External futures/design research tool, not an original Speculative Everything term.

model_constraints: Separate the pull of the future, push of the present, and weight of history.
Do not collapse the three forces into a generic trend list.
Make tensions between forces explicit before proposing interventions.
Use the input as research material; do not require the user to provide futures-method terminology.
For text outputs, return the package text_blocks sequence with force tables and explicitly non-predictive discussion-weight charts.
Preserve the required tool information structure while using the package output_budget; remove repeated framing and keep evidence, tables, and questions concise.

reject_if: treats the future as a single prediction

ui.short_description: Map forces pulling, pushing, and slowing a future.

recommendation.reason: Futures Triangle is primarily an analytic mapping tool; structured text best separates pulls of the future, pushes of the present, and weights of the past.
best_when: The input concerns system change, slow adoption, institutional resistance, or competing visions.
The user needs to understand forces before producing speculative artifacts.
A later diagram or scenario should be grounded in explicit drivers and tensions.

multimodal: structured force map plus diagram prompt

warnings: Use it as analysis before artifact generation; it does not by itself create a finished design fiction.
